== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍分隊指揮官</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">きっかり3人の兵員／トルーパーからなる“分隊”とともに移動する場合、1フォースで4人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーはそれぞれ没収値＋1。「帝国軍警備兵員」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">モッド・テリック大尉は、デザート・サンズ・サンドトルーパー部隊のごく典型的な士官である。勇敢で忠誠心が強い。必要とあらば、兵員たちを犠牲にすることも厭わない。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Imperial Squad Leader]].

'''Lore''' — Captain Mod Terrik is a very typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. He is brave and loyal. If necessary, he does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops.

'''Game text''' — When moving with a squad of exactly three personnel or troopers, all four may move for 1 Force. Personnel or troopers on the same location card are each forfeit +1. Imperial Trooper Guards can move if they are with the squad leader. Force is used as usual.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore says loyal rather than highly motivated. Game text uses 兵員／トルーパー and 位置カード, does not say your troopers, and names Imperial Trooper Guards 「帝国軍警備兵員」. The English face says your troopers at the same site.<ref>[[:File:ANewHope-D-imperialsquadleader-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Squad Leader]].</ref>
